title: Local Plan Policy Schema
description: Schema for a local plan policy.

reference.description: A reference for the policy that is unique within the plan and permanent: it must not change when the plan is updated.

raw-text.description: The exact verbatim text of the policy clause.

evidence.description: References to the plan's policy documents that provide evidence for this policy.

supporting.description: References to the plan's policy documents that support this policy without being evidence for it.

boundaries.description: Spatial boundaries the policy applies to, either in full or by reference.

boundary-reference.description: The reference of a boundary defined elsewhere, such as the plan's local-plan-boundary.

layers.description: Spatial layers associated with the policy.
